verdict.rationale: The only questionnaire-related evidence is a generic API claim to "automate questionnaires". Nothing documents importing SIG, CAIQ, portal or spreadsheet questionnaires, or exporting answers back in the customer's original format. Generic questionnaire automation is an adjacent capability, not the format-preserving import/export this story asks for.

support.subject: As a sales lead, questionnaires arrive in every shape — SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets — and the platform imports and exports them in the format the customer sent
